{"consolidated_memory":"## Signature Mismatch in Key Rotation (crypto/keys/rotation.py)

Recurring problem affecting crypto/keys/rotation.py security module. Same code area involved across all occasions. Common repro pattern: rotate the signing key while requests are in flight. Common signal: verification failure against the previous key.

### Occasion 1: [2026-03-04] OAuth Provider Sessions
- Affected: sessions arriving through OAuth provider only
- Root cause: error swallowed by bare except clause
- Fix: narrowed the exception handler to let the failure propagate
- PR #2717, branch fix/signature-mismatch-1
- Result: backlog cleared 56 minutes after deploy

### Occasion 2: [2026-03-15] Five Percent Rollout Bucket
- Affected: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket only
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to use a monotonic clock
- PR #7949, branch fix/signature-mismatch-2
- Result: job completed in 76 minutes instead of 9 hours

### Occasion 3: [2026-07-28] Negative UTC Offset Users
- Affected: users sitting in a negative UTC offset only
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware (timezone-aware) datetime
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #8193, branch fix/signature-mismatch-3
- Result: alert stayed quiet for 87 consecutive days (no recurrence detected through that period)"}
